title: Fruza Mandarin Mango Freeze 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Introducing Mandarin Mango Freeze by Fruza Nic Salts, a vibrant and frosty tropical mix. This flavour pairs the juicy, sweet notes of ripe Mango with the sharp, zesty tang of Mandarin. A powerful cooling freeze effect rounds out the profile, making this a bold and invigorating fruit ice flavour. The Fruza Nic Salts range is crafted for vapers seeking clear, intense, and authentic flavours. Inspired by Japanese precision and artistry, each 10ml e-liquid features a double concentration of flavour, designed to provide a rich and punchy taste experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It produces a discreet amount of vapour while carrying flavour exceptionally well. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit, even at higher nicotine levels, providing satisfying and rapid nicotine relief. Fruza Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of vapers. They are ideal for use in low-wattage pod vape kits and starter vape kits This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant, featuring a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety. All Fruza e-liquid is made in the UK with high-quality ingredients for a premium and reliable vape.
